metadata.tool_mechanism: Two free dynamic lever halves, the original opening-spring hinge, and two passive normal-axis pad slides. Only robot finger contact closes the tool.
metadata.jaw_gap_definition: Measured inner pad-face separation along the current lower-pad normal; includes both actual passive pad compressions.
draft_assumptions: 150 g overlap-counted compound tool; engine-derived inertia.
Opening spring, damping, friction and contact compliance are draft fixture values.
Prescribed vertical carriage replaces the robot arm. Initial jaws already straddle the flat; transportation and alignment are not evaluated.
MuJoCo contact success does not establish PhysX/YAM transfer, wafer stress limits or cleanroom suitability.

The0.2Nms/rad hinge damper is an explicit unmeasured mechanical draft; the spring/rest/0.3Nm native cap are unchanged. Saved actual q/qdot must keep the unconstrained SI torque within0.3Nm before any native clipping.
Each pad mass includes its backing assembly; uniform effective inertia is a draft approximation.
Pad-mount stiffness and damping are explicit shared draft assumptions, not measured hardware data; non-pad lever masses are proportionally redistributed to preserve each original half total.
Uncoupled mode diagnostics do not establish stability of coupled wafer contacts.
Native8N spring caps exceed the declared q/qdot envelope; the prospective accepted unconstrained spring force remains limited to4N and pad speed to0.05m/s.
Explicit SI mount springs are shared across engines; remaining rigid-contact constraint/compliance and friction algorithms are still not equivalent.

wafer_collision_partition.mass_distribution: Explicit original uniform-solid inertia; overlapping collision geoms carry zero additional mass.
wafer_collision_partition.representation: Continuous front cap under both pads; overlap only at the rear partition edge.

unchanged: Passive hinge spring, limits and friction
changed: Four side guides taper to backing at both X entry ends
retention_candidate.topology: Two free dynamic lever halves connected only by the original passive hinge; no additional actuator or attachment.
retention_candidate.entry: Convex eight-vertex guide prisms; no vertical end wall, overhang or undercut. Flat central guide length20mm.
retention_candidate.tradeoff: Less lateral/yaw constraint near guide ends; broad central stops retained. Normal-contact reactions and retention require physical testing.
retention_candidate.end_rib_mass_rule: Removed rib mass retained in its broad handle; COM/inertia recomputed.

numerical_timing.scope: Shared mechanical draft and integration cadence; original wafer acceptance retained.

metadata.pad_compliance_scope: Two passive normal-axis springs with constant zero rest. No independent closing actuator, commanded pad motion or wafer attachment.

cycle_layout.handle_remap: Opposite-side grip; mirrored lateral guides and rear stop. Passive jaws unchanged.

full_cycle_handle_geometry.mass_rule: Lateral-guide mass redistributed into each physical broad handle; COM and inertia recomputed.
full_cycle_handle_geometry.sizing: Connected edge and axial shoulders locate the fingers. Each paddle retains 10 g distributed by physical volume.
full_cycle_handle_geometry.topology: Two unpowered pitch hinges on physical handle paddles; robot fingers provide all squeezing force.

development_lower_retaining_lip.name: development_lower_retaining_lip_v1
development_lower_retaining_lip.scope: Passive physical stop; unchanged contact material, force limits and retention criteria.

handle_paddle_capacity_profile.numerical_drive_cap: 100 mNm prevents clipping the full-range linear spring; accepted raw torque remains at most 60 mNm. Historical specifications without an operating guard use their authored force cap.
handle_paddle_capacity_profile.rationale: A 20 g wafer about 150 mm ahead of the grip contributes about 29.5 mNm gravity moment. The 25 mNm diagnostic is below this ordinary load; the accepted operating torque limit is 60 mNm. Contact, retention and task checks remain independent.

wafer.source: Explicit MJCF body inertial; zero-mass overlapping collision pieces do not contribute mass.

usd_export.shared_geometry: Baseline primitives with 16 mm physical handle lands; compound 10 g paddle inertia recomputed by volume.

actuation.effort_limit_basis: Fixed0.3Nm native cap. Every recorded physics step must also pass the unchanged0.3Nm raw spring/damper torque guard; no automatic cap inflation.

passive_springs.effort_limit_basis: Fixed0.3Nm native cap. Every recorded physics step must also pass the unchanged0.3Nm raw spring/damper torque guard; no automatic cap inflation.

limitations: Schema/geometry export is not a PhysX physical grasp result.
MuJoCo and PhysX solvers/contact compliance differ despite shared geometry and inertia.
Explicit MuJoCo wafer-pad sliding friction is mapped to pad materials; other pad contacts and rolling/torsional friction are not equivalent.

Two explicit SI pad springs use constant linear force drives. Native8N caps exceed the7N position/speed rectangle bound; the separate prospective force guard remains4N. No accepted state reaches native clipping; this is not engine equivalence.
Full-tool internal collision eligibility matches the local pair map; connected bodies remain filtered. No wafer attachment or world joint is authored.

tool_self_collision.scope: Internal collision eligibility only; contact responses differ between physics engines.

handle_contact_compliance.scope: Draft elastic handle lining; 5 N corresponds to 0.1 mm static indentation per contact. Not calibrated hardware.

handle_contact_compliance.scope: Draft elastic handle lining; 5 N corresponds to 0.1 mm static indentation per contact. Not calibrated hardware.

docking_hold_controller.scope: Hold the last arm command once aligned; resume on measured drift. Controller targets remain distinct from the clearance readiness check.

native_mechanical_revision.alignment: Measured open-jaw clearance governs docking readiness; centering error remains diagnostic.
native_mechanical_revision.retention_frame: Actual finger-contact paddles; unchanged instantaneous 2 mm / 3 deg limits.
native_mechanical_revision.acceptance_change_scope: User-authorized open-jaw clearance readiness replaces exact normal centering; physical grip, retention and collision limits remain unchanged. Future runs only. Whole-wafer stillness is diagnostic; secure retained lifting and placement remain required.
native_mechanical_revision.stationary_hold_controller: After one second on target, latch arm targets; resume correction if measured jaw error exceeds 1.5 mm or 0.75 degrees. Acceptance limits unchanged.
native_mechanical_revision.evaluation_optimization: Use existing compact evaluator fields for the prefix; complete recorded trace and all checks retained.

native_solver_contact_order.scope: Native PGS solver comparison; unchanged geometry, friction, drives, timestep and acceptance.

docking_acceptance_change.authorization: User requested successful pickup and holding without unnecessary precision on 2026-11-11.
docking_acceptance_change.center_and_full_3d_error: Diagnostic only; measured face and housing clearance governs wafer-normal readiness.
docking_acceptance_change.retained: Bilateral contact, pickup, load, collision, wafer retention, hold and return checks.
docking_acceptance_change.historical_results: Unchanged; this policy applies to future runs.

hold_acceptance.scope: Whole-wafer stillness is diagnostic. Lift height, pillar clearance, tilt, jaw engagement, bilateral contact, relative slip, release and stable placement remain acceptance criteria.
hold_acceptance.historical_results: Unchanged; applies only to future runs.

native_mechanical_revision.evaluation_storage: Reuse compact prefix fields and a bounded 256-block stage cache; every physics sample and acceptance check is retained.

passive_hinge_guard.checked_at: Every saved physics sample, using actual joint velocity
passive_hinge_guard.scope: Prospective mechanical-damper diagnostic; unchanged0.3Nm native cap, not calibrated hardware torque or a relaxed wafer criterion.
